items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: INTERVIEWER: He's not talking about Faith Mara, boy.

ctx.x: I started off Tony Perranti. Tony Perranti. All of them big shots, man. I can't have all of them. You know what I used to do is I used to get to the carnival parade, you know? I'm getting close. Who's the guy knocked on Santos' door when he first got a trombone? Yeah, it wasn't you, huh?
Faith. Faith? Yeah. Who's that? He's not talking about Faith Mara, boy. No, he ain't a good story on the television. Oh, I don't know. They winsteyn's program, hey?
Oh, boy, that's all green juice. Nobody knocked with these doors.
